heading_en: Buckets, Risk Weights and Correlations for Delta Risk of Credit Spread Risk on Non-Securitization Products
summary_ja: 非証券化商品に係る信用スプレッド・リスクのデルタ・リスクについて、バケット分類、リスク・ウェイト、リスク・ファクター間及びバケット間の相関係数を定める。
summary_en: Sets the bucket classification, risk weights and the correlation coefficients between risk factors and between buckets for delta risk of credit spread risk on non-securitization products.
paragraphs: For delta risk of credit spread risk on non-securitization products, risk factors shall be classified as provided below. (i) They shall be classified into eighteen buckets according to the categories of credit quality listed in the middle column and sector listed in the lower column of the following table. {{T:p366t1}}. (ii) The classification of sectors in the preceding item shall be based on classifications generally used in the market and shall satisfy all of the following requirements. (a) Each issuer shall be classified into exactly one bucket number. (b) Where an issuer cannot be classified into an individual sector, it shall be classified into bucket number 16.

The risk weights used for delta risk of credit spread risk on non-securitization products shall be as prescribed in the lower column of the following table according to the category of bucket number listed in the upper column of the same table (meaning the bucket number classified under the preceding paragraph; the same applies below in this Article). In this case, the risk weights for all tenors within each bucket (0.5 years, 1 year, 3 years, 5 years or 10 years) shall be the same. {{T:p368t0}} (Note) Where an issuer classified into bucket number 8 satisfies all of the requirements listed in the items of Article 30-2, paragraph (6), and the credit risk category is 3-2-1, the risk weight may be 1.5%.

The correlation coefficient (ρ_{kl}) between risk factors used for delta risk of credit spread risk on non-securitization products shall, where the bucket falls under any of bucket numbers 1 through 18 (excluding bucket number 16), be calculated by the following formula. {{F:p368i0}}

In the formula of the preceding paragraph, the values of {{F:p368i1}}, {{F:p368i2}} and {{F:p368i3}} shall, where the bucket falls under any of bucket numbers 1 through 15, be as prescribed in each of the following items according to the following categories of correlation coefficient. (i) {{F:p368i4}}: the value prescribed in (a) or (b) below according to the following cases. (a) Where the name of sensitivity k and the name of sensitivity l are the same: 100%. (b) In cases other than (a): 35%. (ii) {{F:p368i5}}: the value prescribed in (a) or (b) below according to the following cases. (a) Where the tenor of sensitivity k and the tenor of sensitivity l are the same: 100%. (b) In cases other than (a): 65%. (iii) {{F:p369i0}}: the value prescribed in (a) or (b) below according to the following cases. (a) Where sensitivity k and sensitivity l relate to the same curve: 100%. (b) In cases other than (a): 99.9%.

The values of {{F:p369i1}}, {{F:p369i2}} and {{F:p369i3}} in the formula of paragraph (3) shall, where the bucket falls under bucket number 17 or 18, be as prescribed in each of the following items according to the following categories of correlation coefficient. (i) {{F:p369i4}}: the value prescribed in (a) or (b) below according to the following cases. (a) Where the name of sensitivity k and the name of sensitivity l are the same: 100%. (b) In cases other than (a): 80%. (ii) {{F:p369i5}}: the value prescribed in (a) or (b) below according to the following cases. (a) Where the tenor of sensitivity k and the tenor of sensitivity l are the same: 100%. (b) In cases other than (a): 65%. (iii) {{F:p369i6}}: the value prescribed in (a) or (b) below according to the following cases. (a) Where sensitivity k and sensitivity l relate to the same curve: 100%. (b) In cases other than (a): 99.9%.
